boundary: Restricted exact mathematical results under the prototype REAL policy. Manual degree/domain rules do not authenticate controller numeric algorithms, rounding, signed zero, alarms or task behavior.

rules.documented: REAL angle in degrees, inclusive -18000..18000; result is REAL sine/cosine. Inputs outside the range cause an error in KAREL.
rules.implemented: Check exact normal-or-zero REAL input and documented range before rational modulo 360. SIN supports reduced angles 0,30,90,150,180,210,270,330. COS supports 0,60,90,120,180,240,270,300. Results are 0, +/-0.5 or +/-1 as mathematical identities.
rules.restriction: Other angles remain explicitly rejected, including valid mathematical inputs such as SIN(45) and COS(30). No host libm/radian conversion, approximation or tolerance snapping. Numeric output at these exact identities is a prototype contract, not an observed native result.
rules.tests: tests/test_trigonometry.py: circle values, negative angles, periods, complement/odd/even identities, boundaries and nearby failures

rules.documented: REAL degree angle in -18000..18000; the example relates TAN(angle) to SIN(angle)/COS(angle).
rules.implemented: After input/range checks, rational modulo 180 supports reduced angles 0,45,135 with results 0,1,-1. Odd multiples of 90 degrees receive an explicit undefined-domain error.
rules.restriction: Other angles remain blocked pending numeric rounding evidence. Tangent-pole exception text/type is an offline diagnostic, not native alarm or task-abort evidence.
rules.tests: tests/test_trigonometry.py: diagonals/axes, all half turns and poles, negative periods and domain/order guards

rules.documented: Both take a REAL value in -1..1 and return the inverse angle in degrees. Explicit examples give ASIN(-1)=-90 and ACOS(-1)=180.
rules.implemented: After REAL/domain checks, only -1,-0.5,0,0.5,1 are supported. ASIN returns -90,-30,0,30,90; ACOS returns 180,120,90,60,0. Principal values follow standard inverse definitions and the documented examples.
rules.restriction: Other in-domain values fail pending rounding evidence; near endpoints are not snapped. No rounded intermediate inverse value is accepted just because a later expression might cancel it.
rules.tests: tests/test_trigonometry.py: endpoint/half/zero values, principal roundtrips, complement identity, domain edges and unsupported rational inputs

rules.implemented: INTEGER/BYTE/SHORT inputs use existing checked REAL promotion. One argument is evaluated once. Nested built-ins and routine results/arguments retain existing type, effects, order, FOR, ABORT and frame-cleanup guards. Dynamic failures precede destination writes; prior independent effects persist.
rules.restriction: Existing underflow normalization runs first; signed zero remains normalized. Built-ins in CONST remain unsupported by the restricted constant evaluator. EXP, LN, arbitrary trig rounding and controller numeric/alarm equivalence remain unimplemented.
rules.tests: tests/test_trigonometry.py: source forms, reports/locations, single evaluation, failures/ABORT, side effects, wrong types and arity
